## Question and prerequisites

What problem does this component solve? What must the reader understand first? Link the roadmap gate and relevant previous module.

## What we built

Explain the smallest useful implementation, its boundaries, and relevant code/config paths. Include a diagram only if it helps.

## How it works internally

Follow one concrete input through the component. Show relevant shapes, coordinate systems, state transitions, or timing boundaries. Define any equations or terminology used.

## Experiment

- Hypothesis and expected result:
- Controlled variables and changed variable:
- Dataset/split/manifest and artifact identities:
- Source revision, environment, seed, resolved config, run ID:

## Failure and debugging

Describe the symptom, diagnostic evidence, root cause or remaining hypothesis, fix, and verification. Do not present an untested explanation as a finding.

## Design tradeoffs

What alternatives were considered? Why was this choice appropriate for the scope? What evidence would justify changing it? Link an ADR if the choice affects the wider system.

## Lessons and teach-back

Record what we actually learned and one or two questions a reader should now be able to answer. Separate open questions from established results.

## Completion evidence

Map the roadmap gate to commands/results/tests. Record limitations and the next step. Mark unrun checks explicitly.

## References

Link primary papers, documentation, and relevant local code or reports.
